description: This file defines the TalkModeManager class, which manages speech recognition, text-to-speech playback, and chat interactions for an Android voice application. It handles voice input, TTS output, chat session subscriptions, and related state management, integrating with Android speech and audio APIs, and orchestrating asynchronous operations using coroutines.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, and chat session interactions within an Android voice-based application. It encapsulates state management, event handling, and integration with Android's speech APIs, enabling voice commands, assistant responses, and chat subscriptions.

methods.name: ensureChatSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures the chat session is subscribed by sending a subscribe event to the session if supported.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key used for chat operations.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice recognition and related features, starting or stopping necessary processes.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Initiates a speech conversation using a wake command, prompting chat, waiting for response, and optionally playing assistant reply.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays a given text string using TextToSpeech playback.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming events from the gateway, updating state or triggering TTS responses as appropriate.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables TTS playback for the app.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Reloads configuration settings for talk mode.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Speaks a given assistant reply text.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Activates voice recognition, configuring the SpeechRecognizer and starting listening.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Ceases voice recognition and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Starts the SpeechRecognizer listening process with a specific intent.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the speech recognition process after a delay.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Handles partial and final speech recognition transcripts, manages interrupt logic.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Starts monitoring for silence to finalize speech input.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if silence duration exceeds threshold and triggers transcript finalization.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Finalizes the recognition process, sends chat message, and initiates assistant reply.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes the session to chat updates if not already subscribed.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Builds the chat prompt string containing instructions and user transcript.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message and returns the assigned runId.

methods.name: waitForChatFinal
methods.description: Waits for chat response finalization for a specific runId.

methods.name: cacheRunCompletion
methods.description: Caches the state of chat run completion (final or not).

methods.name: consumeRunCompletion
methods.description: Removes and returns the cached completion state for a given runId.

methods.name: consumeRunText
methods.description: Removes and returns the cached text of a chat run.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatEventMessage
methods.description: Extracts textual content from a chat event message JSON element.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Waits for assistant text after a chat, polling until received or timeout.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches the latest assistant message from chat history based on timestamp.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles the playback of assistant's response, including parsing directives and TTS.

methods.name: runPlaybackSession
methods.description: Runs a playback session, managing TTS lifecycle and calling provided block.

methods.name: cancelActivePlayback
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing TTS playback.

methods.name: speakWithSystemTts
methods.description: Uses Android's TextToSpeech to produce spoken output of text.

methods.name: stopTts
methods.description: Stops ongoing TTS playback and resets state.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops speech output and optionally resets interrupt state.

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterrupt
methods.description: Determines whether speech interrupt is allowed.

methods.name: clearListenWatchdog
methods.description: Cancels the listen watchdog coroutine.

methods.name: requestAudioFocusForTts
methods.description: Requests Android audio focus for TTS playback.

methods.name: abandonAudioFocus
methods.description: Releases Android audio focus.

methods.name: ensureTextToSpeech
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the TextToSpeech engine, ensuring singleton property.

methods.name: stopTextToSpeechPlayback
methods.description: Stops ongoing TTS playback.

methods.name: shutdownTextToSpeech
methods.description: Shuts down and cleans up TextToSpeech resources.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if recognition should be interrupted based on current spoken text and transcript.

methods.name: ensurePlaybackActive
methods.description: Validates that playback can proceed based on current generation and enabled state.

methods.name: isPlaybackCancelled
methods.description: Checks if playback was canceled due to errors or state.

methods.name: ensureConfigLoaded
methods.description: Ensures current configuration is loaded, reloads if necessary.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Fetches and applies configuration settings for silence timeout and interrupt behavior.

methods.name: parseRunId
